name: browser-use
headline: Skills to Extensions - Convert Claude to Gemini
short_description: Automatically convert Anthropic Claude skills into self-contained Google Gemini extensions with a universal MCP server. Ideal for operations teams managing multi-agent workflows.
author: simongwatts

sections.overview:
Skills to Extensions Converter is a Python command-line tool that automates the migration of Anthropic Claude skills to Google Gemini extension format. It recursively discovers skills, converts them, and injects a universal MCP server that enables extensions to read their own files. Once installed in Gemini CLI's global directory, all converted skills load into the model's context on startup, giving it immediate awareness of its full capabilities. This tool is ideal for operations teams managing multi-agent workflows who need to reuse existing Claude skills in Gemini environments. The conversion process is transparent and safe, outputting to a local folder before manual installation to ~/.gemini/extensions.
Migrate existing Claude skill libraries to Google Gemini CLI
Enable multi-agent workflows with shared skills across platforms
Establish global skill context for Gemini models on startup
Convert batch skill repositories with recursive directory scanning
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/simongwatts/skills-to-extensions`
sections.usage:
```
Convert the following Anthropic Claude skill into a self-contained Google Gemini extension. Skill name: [SKILL_NAME]. Skill description: [SKILL_DESCRIPTION]. Skill prompt template: [SKILL_PROMPT]. Ensure the extension is compatible with the universal MCP server for multi-agent workflows.
```
